item.description: I am a third year PhD student in economics at Emory University. My research interests are in the economics of procurement and international trade. I joined Emory from Australia having graduated with a Bachelor of Economics from the University of Adelaide. Before Emory I worked at public policy institutions in Australia. CV (Updated December 2025) My GitHub

* denotes presentation 2025: Dynamic Structural Econometrics 2025 (UCL), Applied Macroeconomic Workshops (Emory University)*, Atlanta Workshop on International Economics (Atlanta Fed) 2024: Firm Dynamics and the Macroeconomy (Atlanta Fed), Business Cycle Fluctuations: The Labor Market (Atlanta Fed)
